card.fact_statement: Tyler James Kay was sentenced to 38 months in prison for copying Lucy Connolly's posts.
card.source_span: On 9 August 2024, a 26-year old man, Tyler James Kay, was sentenced to 38 months (to serve up to half) for copying Connolly's posts.
